metadata.step_method: gufo bench --draft-policy fixed --draft-tokens 1 and 15, -p 512 -n 96 -d 0,4096,16384,32768,65536, --draft-trace; least-squares fit of drafting time (cycle begin to rows complete) over drafter steps per depth, excluding each depth's first (cold) cycle. 31B: UD-Q4_K_XL + gemma-4-31B-it-assistant.Q8_0; 26B: UD-Q4_K_XL + Unsloth mtp-gemma-4-26B-A4B-it. A 7-step run at d0 confirmed linearity on 31B.
metadata.abba_method: Fresh server per arm, base1/cand1/cand2/base2, same HTTP history as mtp-attention-e2e-2026-10-20 default mode (16-token warmup, cold ~31K summary400, essay400, code-edit512), greedy seed 1, thinking off, context 40960, sessions 1, --draft-trace on in every arm. Phase rule: >5% and >3 ms in both pairs.
